outputs.explanation: Panel A is a schematic (genomic organization diagram), not a plot of data.

Panel B shows mean ± SEM inhibition zone values with individual biological replicate values overlaid as gray dots, as stated in the caption. The accompanying disk diffusion images are photographs, not plots.
Panel C shows mean ± SEM inhibition zone values with individual gray dots for each replicate visible on the plot.
Panel D shows mean ± SEM inhibition zone values with individual gray dots for each replicate visible on the plot.
Panel E is a line plot of growth curves (mean ± SEM); line plots are exempt from requiring individual point overlays since this would make them unreadable.
